implementation_summary: Extended the existing shared controller source-attempt registry, rather than adding another authority framework, so exact lane and fusion executor/minter code pairs share one monotonic epoch and carry an authenticated lane_search or fusion source-kind binding. Fusion attempts are discarded on failed execution or issuance and successful FusionReceipts are recorded only by the existing authenticated fusion minter.

Extended the existing controller source preparation gate to accept only exact LaneSearchReceipt or FusionReceipt instances for nonterminal work. The existing resolver still binds action kind, obligation, root source, store/config/runtime, outcome and call-performed rows; the shared claim cutoff rejects pre-claim fusion attempts even when their receipts finish later.

Added private _execute_controller_first_fusion_step with no caller-supplied obligation, receipts, outcome, evidence or hashes. It validates the exact revision-2/ordinal-3 selected fuse and remaining budget, recursively reads the retained lexical and dense transition records, recovers their one exact first obligation and same-round applied/empty lane receipts, requires pristine child fusion consumption, then claims the controller step before invoking the existing fusion executor.

Reused the existing fusion executor, source projection/preparation/binding, structural effect bridge, ActionEffectReceipt authority and controller claim history. Failure after claim tombstones the controller step; child fusion failure or completed computation remains consumed, sanitized fusion_contract_error behavior is preserved, and no error receipt, partial effect or revision-3 successor is manufactured.

Extended the existing bounded transition/successor factory to revision 3. The fusion effect is sourced from the exact FusionReceipt with action fuse, source fusion, call_performed true and step 3; the copied ledger appends only the fuse action and count 3 while preserving the dense/lexical lane tuple, round indexes, unavailable actions, no-progress streaks and sibling obligations. The semantic state and progress fingerprint remain unchanged.

Added the private revision-3-only transition reader and recursive public execution validation while leaving the revision-1 and revision-2 readers restricted. Revision-3 authority retains the immediate revision-2 predecessor and stable initial root, and readback revalidates the fusion source plus both prior lane sources and transitions.

Added synthetic focused coverage for fact and compare across all four applied/empty pairs, lexical-only rescue, both-empty, budget/error preflight, clone/mixed/wrong-snapshot inputs, concurrency, temporal pre-claim admission, wrong-source binding, post-dispatch and sanitized failures, exact ledger/effect/transition fields, GC retention, drift rejection, reader bounds and private API containment. Existing step-history and E0 fusion tests remained byte-identical and passed in adjacent, isolated and full regression.
